name: images
description: Keep the latest image of each service across several release packages: images to build from App/services and images to transfer from scripts/deploy/image_transfer.sh, for docker.build, builtin.shell and oc.deployment.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: release_directory
arguments.description: Folder of release packages (ZIPs or extracted folders), applied in natural name order (H9 before H10). Give this or 'releases'.

arguments.name: releases
arguments.description: Release packages (ZIPs or extracted folders), applied in exactly this order. Give this or 'release_directory'.

arguments.name: image_tag
arguments.description: Tag the images from App/services are built and deployed with.

arguments.name: docker_repository
arguments.description: Last released images (<docker_repository>/<service>/image); a service whose image is identical is not built. Without it, every service in the releases is built.

arguments.name: yaml_repository
arguments.description: YAML repository with .entropy/resource_index.json; needed to produce the 'deployments' output. Without it, that output is empty.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Where the images, the transfer script and consolidation-report.json are written; defaults to <workspace>/consolidated/images.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Empty a non-empty output_directory first (otherwise such a folder is refused, so stale images are never built).

outputs.name: output_directory
outputs.description: Folder holding the staged images, the transfer script and the report.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Path of consolidation-report.json: the release each image came from, Deployment updates and warnings.

outputs.name: releases
outputs.description: Release names in the order they were applied.

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: Images to build; give it to docker.build as 'images'. Empty when nothing needs building.

outputs.name: transfer_script
outputs.description: Generated script that transfers the latest images; give it to builtin.shell as 'script'. Always written, and does nothing when there are no images.

outputs.name: deployments
outputs.description: Image updates; give them to oc.deployment as 'deployments' (deployments mode). Empty without yaml_repository.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: True when there is an image to build or transfer.
